coa_expiry_2m_body: Your Health Certificate expires on {date}. Contact Environmental Health to schedule a renewal inspection.
coa_expiry_1m_body: Your Health Certificate expires on {date}. Bring your Food Safety Evidence Pack to your inspection.
coa_expiry_expired_body: Your Health Certificate has expired. Your shop could be closed. Contact Environmental Health immediately to renew.
permit_expiry_2m_body: Your trading permit expires on {date}. Start your renewal at the municipal office.
permit_expiry_1m_body: Your trading permit expires on {date}. Renew now to avoid closure.
permit_expiry_expired_body: Your trading permit has expired. Renew immediately to keep trading legally.
cipc_annual_body: Your CIPC annual return for {year} is due. File at bizportal.gov.za to keep your registration active. Cost: R30.
visa_90d_body: Your visa expires on {date}. Start your renewal now — your trading permit is linked to your visa.
visa_60d_body: Your visa expires on {date}. Renew soon to avoid losing your trading permit.
visa_30d_body: Your visa expires on {date}. Your trading permit becomes invalid if your visa expires. Renew immediately.
visa_expired_body: Your visa has expired. Your trading permit is no longer valid. Visit Home Affairs immediately.
journey_nudge_title: Your next compliance step is waiting
journey_nudge_body_municipal_registratio: Step {step}: get your trading permit. We'll guide you through what to bring.
journey_nudge_body_coa: Step {step}: get your Health Certificate. Most applications take 1–2 weeks.
journey_nudge_body_cipc: Step {step}: register your business with CIPC. Costs R175 online.
journey_nudge_body_sars_tax: Step {step}: register with SARS for tax. It's free and takes 10 minutes online.
journey_nudge_body_uif: Step {step}: register with UIF. Required when you have employees.
journey_nudge_body_food_safety_training: Step {step}: complete food safety training. Needed before your Health Certificate.
journey_nudge_body_smmesa: Step {step}: register with SMMESA. Required for the government fund.
fund_nudge_title: You're close to qualifying for the fund
fund_nudge_body: Your compliance score is {score}/100. Complete the next step to qualify for up to R300,000 in support.
fund_qualified_title: You qualify for the Spaza Shop Support Fund
fund_qualified_body: Generate your application pack and apply now — you could receive up to R300,000.
score_drop_amber_body: A few items need attention before your next inspection.
score_drop_red_body: Multiple areas need attention. Your shop may not pass an inspection right now.
checklist_streak_title: You haven't done your checklist in {days} days
checklist_streak_body: Daily checklists keep your compliance score up and your inspection ready. Take 30 seconds to fill in today's.

products_missing_supplier_title: {count} پروڈکٹس سے سپلائر منسلک نہیں ہے
products_missing_supplier_body: سپلائرز کو منسلک کرنا دوبارہ اسٹاک کرنا تیز کر دیتا ہے۔
